title: Injective-immersion area formula on a Borel subset of ℝ^m with Gram-determinant Jacobian
statement:
Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let G : ℝ^m → ℝ^P, and let F ⊆ ℝ^m be a Borel set. Assume G is differentiable at every v ∈ F with injective derivative DG(v), and G is injective on F. Let e_0, …, e_{m−1} be the standard basis of ℝ^m.

Then for every function h : ℝ^P → ℝ:
∫_{G(F)} h dH^m = ∫_F (det[⟨DG(v)e_i, DG(v)e_j⟩]_{i,j<m})^{1/2} · h(G(v)) dL^m(v).

Here H^m = μHE[m] is the normalized m-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P and L^m is Lebesgue measure on ℝ^m. Both sides are Bochner integrals; no integrability is assumed, and a non-integrable integral is 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (G : Euclid m → Euclid P) (F : Set (Euclid m)), MeasurableSet F → (∀ v ∈ F, DifferentiableAt ℝ G v) → (∀ v ∈ F, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G v)) → InjOn G F → ∀ h : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ w in G '' F, h w ∂μHE[m] = ∫ v in F, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ G v (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))) * h (G v)
